method.poster: Native 720 x 1280 poster inspected separately: recognizable character, complete limbs and shoes; approximated splayed fingers remain visible.
method.scope: Sampled visual inspection of the generated performance against its motion reference and character concept. No continuous playback or audio verdict.

findings: Riko remains recognizable through the pink cropped sweater, hair ribbons, shorts, and sneakers.
The one-leg balance, free-leg extension, torso angle, and lowering arms follow the coarse reference pose sequence at inspected times.
No major body malformation or character clipping was visible in the inspected samples.
Fine hand poses differ: relaxed reference hands become splayed or V-like fingers.
The plain studio background provides no floor-contact plane; exact physical contact and balance are not established.
The generated leg is somewhat more bent during the extension, and source edge excursions are not reproduced exactly.
publication_scope: An additional reference-driven performance study, with the listed limitations visible alongside it.
limits: Sampled inspection cannot certify every transition.
Fine finger correspondence, exact floor contact, and seamless motion identity are not claimed.
A new stochastic generation needs fresh review.
